Combined with the class rule (BATH = WET_SERVICE_ROOM, the rest DRY) every threshold gets a finish on each side. The STRIP_ALLOCATION release blocker can go for the FLOOR rows. For the CEILING row a door threshold is the door's TOP REVEAL (US-07 left / right / top reveals; door head 2.20 m, QP-21), never ceiling: NOT_IN_TRADE for CEILING, recorded for the reveal trade.
recommendation_before_coding.2_transition_plane: The hierarchy is right, but on this source level 1 does NOT apply: every Qortuba hinge sits ON a wall face, the closed leaf falls on / outside the face and the frame block is not fitted to the wall - a schematic symbol establishes the opening (width, swing, host wall), not the frame plane. Generic rule: AUTHORED_LEAF_PLANE only when the hinge / closed leaf lies STRICTLY inside the reveal (between the two faces, beyond eps_r); a symbol anchored on a face is SYMBOL_ANCHORED_AT_FACE (no plane authority). Then level 3: the owner's scoped DOOR_CENTRED fact applied to the ESTABLISHED parallel face pair (closures A and B): the mid-plane between them. Without that fact the state is UNRESOLVED_TRANSITION_PLANE - never wall thickness / 2 by default.

Jamb depth comes from the source (the band end segment, 200 mm), NOT from US-07's 0.25 m standard - recorded as a reconciliation item for the plaster trade (no plaster quantity this round).
